azurite-qualification.name: azurite-qualification
azurite-qualification.prompt:
Report task: qualify VLite's Azure Blob client (src/server/cloud_backup/azure.rs, EmulatorSharedKey mode) and set protocol (src/server/cloud_backup.rs) against the Azurite emulator; existing tests use only an in-memory fake. Base HEAD f6a8efe3. Never modify tracked files in the checkout: copy the repo to a temp dir OUTSIDE it and do all harness edits there. Never contact real Azure; use only Azurite's publicly documented devstoreaccount1 well-known key, written to a temp key file.
Steps:
1. Read azure.rs (connect/connect_with, Target/AuthMode, read_shared_key, VLITE_CLOUD_BACKUP_SHARED_KEY_FILE) and cloud_backup.rs (store trait, upload/observe/finish, catalog/delete_set/sweep, existing mod tests) to learn construction.
2. Install and start Azurite blob in a temp dir (npm install azurite; azurite-blob --blobHost 127.0.0.1 --blobPort 10000 --inMemoryPersistence --loose; add --skipApiVersionCheck if x-ms-version 2021-08-06 is rejected). Create needed containers.
3. In the temp copy add an #[ignore]d in-crate test module (APIs are pub(in crate::server)) that runs against Azurite: put/get/download/list (pagination if feasible)/delete; If-None-Match:* conflict -> expected error class; stale If-Match -> precondition failure; large put_file streaming plus download read-back hash; size limits; name escaping (spaces, unicode, %, +). Then run the set protocol end to end through the Azure store: STAGING, upload, publish, catalog sees set, pin, janitor refuses pinned delete, unpin, retention delete -> TOMBSTONED, stale publisher cannot publish after tombstone, orphan manifest ignored. Reuse existing fake-store tests by swapping in the Azure store where feasible.
4. Run with `cargo test --lib <module> -- --ignored --nocapture`; record exact commands, rustc and Azurite versions, results.
Report: environment; what passed; each failure with status/header/signature evidence, root-cause file:line and suggested fix; semantic differences between the fake store and Azurite (ETag format, 409 vs 412, listing order, error codes) that could hide bugs; full harness test code in an appendix so it can be committed later. If Azurite cannot run, give the concrete error and still deliver a ready-to-run harness and precise plan. State clearly that emulator results are not real-Azure qualification.
azurite-qualification.title: Azurite emulator qualification of Azure Blob client and set protocol

epic002-review.name: epic002-review
epic002-review.prompt:
Report-only security/correctness review of VLite EPIC-002 (commit c0d274e5, 'Typed sanitized recovery bundle with rekey-only import'); HEAD f6a8efe3 contains it. Design: docs/projects/feature-backup-ha/feature-backup-ha.prd.md section 3.3 items 2-4 and 9, section 8, EPIC-002 ITEM-003/004, AC-003, AC-004 (backup-only rekey-only matrix), FM-006.
Scope: run `git show c0d274e5 --stat`, then review src/server/recovery_bundle.rs and every hunk it changed in users.rs, tenants.rs, credentials.rs, webhooks.rs, admin.rs, server.rs and tests.
Verify with evidence:
1. Bundle never holds plaintext secrets (tokens, TLS keys, provider keys, webhook signing secrets, DB encryption keys, session cookies); only references. Note how password/credential hashes are handled.
2. Excludes sessions, locks, caches, absolute paths, in-progress jobs, machine identity; any unrecognized security-relevant sidecar/field fails certification (fail closed), never silently dropped or copied.
3. Bounded versioned parsing: size limits, unknown-version rejection, no path traversal/symlinks, safe relative names, strict unknown-field handling where needed.
4. Capture is serialized with admin persistence and bound to exact DB/policy identity; partial tenant/account transitions refused.
5. Import is strictly rekey-only: new lineage; every imported account and credential disabled; fresh private break-glass bootstrap; explicit regrants; revoked credentials, disabled tenants and stale sessions can never be revived; import never touches a live DB/admin dir.
6. Errors/logs/Debug never echo secret values.
7. Missing negative tests.
Run the relevant tests (e.g. `cargo test --lib server::recovery_bundle`, adjust filter after reading code, plus any tests/recovery_bundle*.rs binary); record exact commands and pass/fail counts. Throwaway tests or mutations only in a temp copy OUTSIDE the checkout; never modify tracked files. No network except crates.io for builds.
Report: verdict; findings table (ID, severity Critical/High/Medium/Low, file:line, issue, repro or reasoning, suggested fix); confirmed-correct properties with evidence; missing tests; commands and results. High-confidence findings only; label speculation as questions. No secrets in the report.
epic002-review.title: Security/correctness review of EPIC-002 recovery bundle

epic003-review.name: epic003-review
epic003-review.prompt:
Report-only review of VLite EPIC-003 (commit f6a8efe3, 'Azure Blob set protocol with manifest-last publication, pins and retention'). Design: docs/projects/feature-backup-ha/feature-backup-ha.prd.md section 3.3 items 4-7 plus 'Publication/pin/deletion protocol', section 8, ITEM-005, AC-001, AC-002, AC-014, FM-001.
Scope: `git show f6a8efe3 --stat`; review src/server/cloud_backup.rs, src/server/cloud_backup/azure.rs and Cargo changes.
Verify with evidence:
1. Data/config objects uploaded first with unique immutable names; manifest created last with create-if-absent; only a committed PUBLISHED coordination record makes a set recoverable; orphan manifests ignored.
2. Per-set record CAS (ETag and/or lease) linearizes STAGING->PUBLISHED; a paused/stale publisher whose record was tombstoned cannot publish or reuse the set ID; tombstones never recreated.
3. Unknown PUT/CAS outcomes reconcile by exact name/etag/hash/length; never a second logical backup, never success without verification; streamed read-back hash check is bounded.
4. Pins acquired by CAS before any object read; DELETE_PENDING requires zero pins and freezes pins/publication; catalog decision record prevents concurrent janitors deleting all survivors; last verified set, minimum count/age and holds protected; ambiguous decisions stop GC; staging-orphan cleanup separate from deletion.
5. azure.rs: SharedKey string-to-sign matches Microsoft docs for x-ms-version 2021-08-06 (canonicalized headers/resource, Content-Length empty-when-zero rule, query ordering/encoding); shared key restricted to loopback emulator; managed-identity token request uses resource https://storage.azure.com/, IDENTITY_HEADER, cache expiry skew, never logs tokens; bounded response reads; XML listing parse with continuation markers and unescaping; status classification (404/409/412 vs 5xx/timeout -> unknown); conditional writes not blindly retried; redirects/proxies safe.
6. No secret leakage in errors or Debug impls.
Run `cargo test --lib server::cloud_backup` and record counts. You may write extra adversarial tests (interleavings, crash points, fake-store fault injection) in a temp copy OUTSIDE the checkout and run them; put test code in a report appendix if it reveals a bug. Never modify tracked files; never contact real Azure.
Report: verdict; findings table (ID, severity, file:line, issue, repro, fix); confirmed properties; missing tests; commands and results. High-confidence findings only; label speculation as questions. No secrets in the report.
epic003-review.title: Protocol/security review of EPIC-003 Blob set protocol and Azure client
